units.source_text: 父亲领着我毕恭毕敬地登上了法水院的廊道，我首先看到的是摆在玻璃橱里的精致的金阁模型。

en.t: My father led me respectfully up onto the veranda of Hosui-in, and the first thing I saw was an exquisite model of the Golden Pavilion displayed in a glass case.
I liked this model very much.

units.source_text: 毋宁说它接近我梦想中的金阁。

en.t: Rather, it was close to the Golden Pavilion I had dreamed of.

units.source_text: 于是，大金阁的内部藏着模样完全相同的小金阁，让我联想到犹如大宇宙中存在着小宇宙似的无限的呼应。

en.t: Then I imagined a small Golden Pavilion of exactly the same form hidden inside the great one, which made me think of an infinite correspondence, as though a microcosm existed within the macrocosm.
For the first time, I saw it in a dreamlike vision.

units.source_text: 梦幻到比这模型更小巧而且更完整的金阁，以及比真实的金阁更无限大的、几乎包容世界似的金阁。

en.t: I envisioned a Golden Pavilion smaller and more complete than this model, and also a Golden Pavilion infinitely larger than the real one, almost as if it embraced the whole world.
